dataset: Cleveland previously collected 900 CC0 text/image objects
hypothesis: Secondary engineering check of error propagation, valid mandatory dependencies, and the same phase guidance already available to the monolithic baseline; retain all original comparisons.
change_scope: Preserve real exception text, normalize five mandatory stage dependencies, and expose existing deterministic phase defaults. No altered tools, model, budget, faults or outcome gate.
exposure: All controllers have identical cached records, images, frozen CLIP features, confirmed schema, action handlers, audits and model endpoint.

method_definitions.multi_guarded: full role policies with retained exception context, acyclic mandatory dependencies and phase guidance; same handlers, model and budgets
method_definitions.single: one production ReAct policy over qualified union actions, shared observations, same phase hints/defaults and bounded restart tool
method_definitions.script: mandatory forward action schedule; two retries of transient tool errors; no backward feedback scheduling
method_definitions.script_feedback: same script plus bounded upstream restart and descendant invalidation

faults.write_retry: one OSError at first formatter save, then normal writes
faults.partial_edges: first saved builder output retains a fixed 5% edge slice; later builds use full normal output
faults.combined: the same edge truncation plus the same one-time save error

settings.seed_caveat: Requested model seeds do not guarantee service determinism.
settings.endpoint: production 300-epoch-max fused MLP classifier; hidden 256, layers 2, dropout .5, projection 768; initialization equals repetition

success: Independent fresh healthy-build identity/edge/label checks under hash seed 0, all three protocol bundles, real classifier checkpoint, and reloaded test prediction CSV.
assistance: After failed autonomous attempt, one standardized reset-and-script-feedback continuation. This is an assistance proxy, not observed human editing or a user study.
accounting: All initial failures retained. Primary success/time/tokens refer to the autonomous attempt. Assisted time is separate.
latency: CPU evaluation; sequential within rotated matched blocks; no repeated crawling or re-encoding; excludes cold network acquisition.
information_control: Opaque working-directory IDs; condition/method names are absent from request paths seen by policy LLMs. Two matched blocks may run concurrently.

cost.scope: qwen-plus non-thinking <=128K reference API price, no batch/cache discounts; not an invoice or compute cost

pilot: one clean episode per controller, excluded from main campaign; interface fixes allowed before design freeze
